scripts.repack:mobile: npm run pack:shared && npm run pack:api-client
scripts.customer:build:preview:android: npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview --non-interactive --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.customer:build:production:android: npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.customer:build:preview:ios: npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview --non-interactive --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.customer:build:production:ios: npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.customer:update:staging: npx eas-cli update --channel staging --non-interactive --auto --message "customer staging update" --platform android --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.customer:update:production: npx eas-cli update --channel production --non-interactive --auto --message "customer production update" --platform android --project-dir apps/customer
scripts.courier:build:preview:android: npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile preview --non-interactive --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.courier:build:production:android: npx eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --non-interactive --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.courier:build:preview:ios: npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile preview --non-interactive --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.courier:build:production:ios: npx eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --non-interactive --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.courier:update:staging: npx eas-cli update --channel staging --non-interactive --auto --message "courier staging update" --platform android --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.courier:update:production: npx eas-cli update --channel production --non-interactive --auto --message "courier production update" --platform android --project-dir apps/courier
scripts.prepare: node scripts/postinstall.js 2>/dev/null || echo 'Note: After modifying shared packages, run npm run repack:mobile'
scripts.audit:fix: npm audit fix --prefix apps/customer && npm audit fix --prefix apps/courier
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix apps/customer && npm audit --prefix apps/courier
